title: Initial Trade Analysis · Rapid Valley Annihilation ↔ Ravens Regime

However, for Ravens Regime—a playoff contender already boasting Derrick Henry, Kyle Monangai, Tony Pollard, and Tyjae Spears—Blake Corum does not enter the starting lineup or immediate FLEX rotation. Expecting a contender to surrender two top-50 future picks for bench RB depth represents an overask that is unlikely to be accepted. AVI recommends revising the offer to a single 2028 2nd-round pick to establish a realistic, market-aligned proposal.

title: Initial Trade Analysis · Rapid Valley Annihilation ↔ Ravens Regime

analysis.executiveSummary: Rapid Valley Annihilation (Retooling) is proposing sending 25-year-old running back Blake Corum (64.5 C-AVI / 72.7 D-AVI) to playoff contender Ravens Regime for 30-year-old tight end Juwan Johnson (74.5 C-AVI / 78.8 D-AVI) and a late 2027 4th-round draft pick. Although Johnson offers a slight immediate C-AVI increase (+10.0), acquiring an aging tight end when Rapid Valley Annihilation already features 22-year-old cornerstone Colston Loveland (80.1 C-AVI / 89.3 D-AVI) directly contradicts RVA's retool strategy. Furthermore, trading away Corum severely diminishes RVA's running back depth while a 4th-round pick provides zero meaningful draft equity (0.0 AVI). AVI strongly advises declining this proposal and pivoting toward acquiring future 2nd-round draft capital from Ravens Regime instead.

submitted.summary: Rapid Valley Annihilation surrenders a 25-year-old running back asset with contingent upside (Blake Corum) for a 30-year-old tight end (Juwan Johnson) and a zero-value draft pick. For a retooling franchise with Colston Loveland already locked in as the long-term TE starter, acquiring aging TE depth degrades roster age structure and strips RB depth without securing useful draft equity.

recommended.summary: Pivoting from an aging tight end to future 2nd-round draft capital (2028 2nd via Gringo's Goblins) directly aligns with Rapid Valley Annihilation's retool goal while supplying Ravens Regime with valuable running back depth for their playoff push.
